n: Event <Delicious On Terra> is now open

missions: Clear event stages 15 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 45 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 85 times, not including tutorial stages.

list: A soft, non-slip, bright-green carpet adorned with a metal crab flower pattern. Peacake modeled for the carpet design and earned three gourmet treats as payment. She's in great spirits: she bloomed three flowers in a single day!

A stovetop with three burners. There's a sink on the right and an electrical outlet on the left. Matterhorn loves this stovetop, though he wishes the cabinet doors wouldn't hit his horns when they're opened.

A wall cabinet equipped with a range hood, lighting, and strong ventilation to ensure a safe, clean cooking environment. It holds lots of cooking supplies. Be careful when opening it, lest a sharp object fall on your head.

Rhodes Island's fun kitchen flooring, developed by the Engineering Department. It's oil-proof, waterproof, heat-resistant, and resistant to wear, acid, and corrosion. Spilled drinks, stubborn oil stains? A quick wipe, and they're gone.

The operators have piled this table high with scrumptious dishes. There's Goldenglow's electrostatic popcorn, Skyfire's roasted chestnuts, Beanstalk's metal crab flower cupcakes, and Warmy's carrot stew—try not to drool on the table!

A dessert stand specially requested by Beanstalk to showcase her metal crab dessert series. New desserts have arrived! Come enjoy some metal crab flower tea, metal crab flower cupcakes, and metal crab flower cookies!
theme: A room in Rhodes Island for showcasing the operators' culinary talents. Whatever creative cooking ideas you have can come to life here!

list: During the Delicious On Terra event, obtain Operator Senshi.
Improve your diet, rethink your circadian rhythm, and engage in proper exercise. If you pay attention to these three things, your body will naturally get stronger.
During the Delicious On Terra event, complete all stages in [Monster Gourmand] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials and story stages)

Whether you wanted to know or not, you now have a detailed understanding of the composition, texture, flavor, and nutritional value of all sorts of plants and animals across Terra.
Don't take nature so lightly, though. After all, it's eat or be eaten, and you can't say for sure which you'll be.
